title: Typed layer component diagram
description: The typed layer sits on the JSON layer: every typed operation builds UTV JSON, calls a JSON-layer function and turns its UtvResult into a value or an Outcome<T>.

components.name: Typed layer
components.responsibility: Typed values valid by construction, Outcome<T>, typed policies and TemporalContext.

components.name: JSON layer
components.responsibility: Build, Calendar, Iso, TextForm, Ranges, Zones, ZoneRules and Interop: the 0.2 operations on UTV JSON.

components.name: Everyday internals
components.responsibility: Reading and writing UTV JSON, exact rationals, OpFailure.

components.name: .NET base class library
components.responsibility: System.Text.Json (JsonElement), System.Numerics (BigInteger) and the native types the interop methods take and return: DateOnly, TimeOnly, DateTime, DateTimeOffset and TimeSpan.

relationships.description: Calendar.Add, Calendar.Compare, Calendar.Fields, Calendar.DaysBetween, Zones.Resolve, Zones.ToZone, Ranges.Contains, TextForm.Format and Interop answer every typed operation.
Values reads JSON into typed values; OpFailure is caught and becomes an outcome.
ResolutionPolicy has a constructor that takes the typed Gap and Overlap.
FromDateOnly, FromDateTimeOffset, ToDateTimeOffset and the like name the .NET type that carries the intent.
